guide.headline: Lions passing downs crush Panthers everywhere on the field
guide.hook: Detroit's offense breaks Carolina on third-and-long while Aidan Hutchinson tries to wreck the pocket from the other side.

items.title: Lions own third-and-long
items.what: The Lions rank No. 4 of 32 on passing downs, converting 49% of the time, and the Panthers rank No. 26 on defense at just 44%. That is a 71 percentile point gap, not a lean. Two conversions in the first half and the Panthers' whole defensive plan falls apart.
items.when: Any third-and-8 or longer situation for Detroit.

items.title: Hutchinson hunting the quarterback
items.what: Aidan Hutchinson has 3.5 sacks, 7 QB hits, and 3 TFL already this season, playing 88% of defensive snaps as the No. 1 left end on the depth chart. Watch his get-off at the snap and whether he sets the edge against the run instead of just chasing the quarterback.
items.when: Every passing down, especially early in the game before Carolina adjusts protection.

items.title: Panthers answer with the deep ball
items.what: Carolina ranks No. 5 of 32 in pass explosiveness at 1.56, and the Lions rank just No. 19 at limiting it at 1.35, a 45 percentile point gap. Watch the first deep shot Carolina takes. If it connects, the Lions have to roll a safety over and that opens up everything underneath.
items.when: First deep shot of the game, usually on an early drive before the defense adjusts.

guide.cardLine: Detroit's third-and-long offense and Aidan Hutchinson's pass rush put Carolina in a hole it cannot easily climb out of.
